title: Red Hat Security Advisory: libsoup security update
description: Multiple heap buffer overflow vulnerabilities have been identified in the libsoup HTTP client and server library for GNOME. These vulnerabilities affect WebSocket handling, including Pong signal type confusion, message reassembly, receive-buffer growth, client-frame masking, and outgoing permessage-deflate buffer growth. Red Hat has issued security updates addressing these issues in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support and related variants.
